findings.title: Secret logged: api_token written to the log line
findings.body: api_token is interpolated into the log message and will leak into log sinks.
findings.anchor: log.info("uploading report key=%s api_token=%s", key, api_token)

findings.title: Unused import boto3
findings.body: boto3 is imported but never used.

findings.title: Function-local import should move to module top
findings.body: Importing boto3 inside the function adds overhead on every call.

findings.title: Blocking boto3 call inside async def
findings.body: The synchronous put_object blocks the event loop inside upload_many.
